Absolutely constant stroke width around 3% full canvas, round caps and round joins, precise straight bars and rounded smooth curves. No taper, swelling, brush pressure, texture, blobs, or serifs. Preserve every branch, detached stroke, counter, gap, contact and bar length relationship. NO labels, text, codepoints, frames, grids, shadows, watermark, background, multiple glyphs. U+3D115. All four available, choose coherent THX construction. LEFT intertwined double-curve component: two curving long strokes cross twice, forming TWO stacked small diagonal lozenge counters. Upper terminals project upward/outward, one short top right spur. Lower left course ends midway down, lower right course curves inward then descends as long nearly vertical leg to bottom. RIGHT BOTTOM separate curved open spiral tail: outer arc rounds over top/right, curves down-left then long down-curving tail to low center; left outer arc ends at midheight. TWO sloping inner diagonal marks descend toward right from left/top arc, open ends. Keep right upper/lower components detached; do not substitute modern Chinese forms.
